questions.prompt: Return the first integer encountered for a second time, or null if none repeats. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Track seen values; distinguish encounter order from numeric order.

questions.prompt: Compress consecutive equal integers into pairs of value and run length. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Single traversal with a current run; handle empty input.

questions.prompt: Merge two sorted integer arrays into one sorted array, preserving duplicates. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Two cursors and remaining suffix; linear time.

questions.prompt: Read one line from standard input containing brackets and print exactly true or false. Return true when every bracket is correctly nested, otherwise false. Any non-bracket character makes the input invalid and must also print false. Empty input is valid and prints true. Implement this behavior and explain time and auxiliary-space complexity.
examples: Input: ([]) => Output: true; Input: ([)] => Output: false
questions.reviewerNotes: Stack of opening brackets and exact closing matches.

questions.prompt: Return an array rotated right by k positions. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Normalize k when nonempty; explain allocation or reversal approach.

questions.prompt: Return the first index whose value is at least target, or array length if absent. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Binary search with a half-open interval; duplicates.

questions.prompt: An array contains distinct values from 0 through n except one. Return the missing value. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: XOR or wide integer sum; discuss overflow in named language.

questions.prompt: Determine whether two lowercase ASCII strings contain the same letters with the same counts. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Frequency counts and unequal lengths.

questions.prompt: Reverse a singly linked list and return its new head. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Maintain previous/current/next; constant extra space.

questions.prompt: Return the maximum number of nodes on a root-to-leaf path in a binary tree. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
examples: Root with two leaf children => 2; empty tree => 0
questions.reviewerNotes: Traversal with depth; avoid recursion overflow on skewed trees.

questions.prompt: Modify a sorted integer array so its prefix contains each distinct value once; return that prefix length. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Read and write indices; ignore suffix contents.

questions.prompt: Return the distinct integers present in both arrays, sorted ascending. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Set intersection then sorting; distinguish output uniqueness.

questions.prompt: Answer inclusive range-sum queries over a fixed integer array. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; q <= 100000; valid indices; values within +/-1000000000.
questions.reviewerNotes: Prefix sums with wide accumulation; O(n+q).

questions.prompt: Move all zeros to the end in place while preserving the order of nonzero values. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Stable write cursor followed by zero fill.

questions.prompt: Return counts of words separated by one or more ASCII spaces, treating letters case-insensitively. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.constraints: Length <= 100000; input contains ASCII letters and spaces only.
questions.reviewerNotes: Token boundaries, lowercase normalization, empty input.

questions.prompt: Return the length of the longest substring with no repeated character. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Sliding window and last seen positions.

questions.prompt: Count contiguous nonempty subarrays whose sum equals k. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Prefix sum frequencies including zero; wide sums and count.

questions.prompt: Merge overlapping closed intervals and return them sorted by start. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.constraints: n <= 100000; start <= end; endpoints signed integers.
questions.reviewerNotes: Sort then merge; touching intervals overlap.

questions.prompt: Return the k most frequent integers ordered by decreasing count then increasing value. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.constraints: 1 <= k <= number of distinct values; n <= 100000.
questions.reviewerNotes: Frequency map and heap or sorting with explicit tie break.

questions.prompt: Count four-directionally connected groups of 1 cells in a rectangular binary grid. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Iterative flood fill and visited set; diagonal not adjacent.

questions.prompt: Return the lexicographically smallest topological ordering of nodes 0..n-1, or an empty list if cyclic. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.constraints: n <= 100000; unique directed edges <= 200000; edge [a,b] means a before b.
questions.reviewerNotes: Indegree tracking with min heap; detect incomplete traversal.

questions.prompt: Return the fewest coins needed to total amount, or -1 if impossible; each denomination is reusable. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Bottom-up minimum DP with unreachable sentinel.

questions.prompt: Find the lowest common ancestor of two distinct node objects in a binary tree. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
examples: Root 1 with children 2 and 3; targets 2,3 => node 1
questions.constraints: Both targets exist; <= 100000 nodes; values need not be unique.
questions.reviewerNotes: Compare identity; parent map or traversal; deep trees.

questions.prompt: Return the node where a singly linked list cycle starts, or null when acyclic, using constant extra space. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Two-pointer meeting then entrance proof.

questions.prompt: Return for each index the product of all other elements without division. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; all prefix/suffix and output products fit signed 64-bit.
questions.reviewerNotes: Prefix and suffix products; empty product is one.

questions.prompt: For each temperature, return days until a strictly warmer temperature, or zero if none. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Monotonic stack of unresolved indices; equality not warmer.

questions.prompt: Return shortest edge count between source and target in an unweighted undirected graph, or -1. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Breadth-first traversal; source equals target and disconnected nodes.

questions.prompt: Return the kth smallest integer in an unsorted array, counting duplicate occurrences. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Quickselect or bounded heap; discuss worst-case behavior.

questions.prompt: Count decodings of a digit string where 1 maps to A through 26 maps to Z; return count modulo 1000000007. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: One/two digit transitions; zero validity; constant-space DP.

questions.prompt: Implement an integer-key LRU cache with get returning null for missing keys and put replacing or inserting values. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
examples: capacity=2; put(1,8); put(2,9); get(1); put(3,7); get(2) => null
questions.constraints: Capacity 1..100000; <= 200000 operations; expected O(1) per operation.
questions.reviewerNotes: Hash map plus doubly linked list; updates refresh recency.

questions.prompt: Return the maximum in each consecutive window of width k. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Monotonic deque of indices; eviction boundaries.

questions.prompt: Implement add(integer) and median() for an initially empty stream; median averages the two central values for even size. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.constraints: <= 1000000 adds; signed 32-bit values; median called only when nonempty.
questions.reviewerNotes: Two balanced heaps; avoid overflow averaging.

questions.prompt: Return shortest distance from source to every vertex in a directed graph, using null for unreachable nodes. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Dijkstra with stale heap entry checks; wide distances.

questions.prompt: Implement rangeAdd(l,r,delta) and rangeSum(l,r) over an initially zero array, with inclusive indices. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.constraints: n,q <= 200000; valid ranges; all sums fit signed 64-bit; O(log n) per operation.
questions.reviewerNotes: Lazy segment tree or two Fenwick trees; boundary arithmetic.

questions.prompt: Return minimum unit-cost insertions, deletions, and substitutions to transform one string into another using O(min(m,n)) extra space. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Rolling edit-distance rows; preserve diagonal state.

questions.prompt: Return all bridges in a simple undirected graph as sorted endpoint pairs in lexicographic order. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Discovery/low-link traversal; parent handling and stack depth.

questions.prompt: Return the length of a strictly increasing subsequence in O(n log n) time. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Minimal tails with lower bound; duplicates not increasing.

questions.prompt: Decide whether a string can be segmented into nonempty dictionary words; dictionary words may be reused. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.constraints: String <= 10000 lowercase letters; total dictionary characters <= 100000; word length <= 100.
questions.reviewerNotes: Reachability DP with trie or bounded substring lookup; complexity includes hashing.

questions.prompt: Return the shortest substring containing every character of target with multiplicity; break ties by earliest start; return empty if impossible. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Deficit counts and shrinking valid window; preserve multiplicity.

questions.prompt: Return the kth smallest absolute difference among all unordered pairs of array positions. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Sort then binary search distance using two-pointer pair counts.

questions.prompt: Return the maximum profit from nonoverlapping jobs; a job ending at t may precede one starting at t. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Sort by end, binary-search predecessor, wide profit DP.

questions.prompt: Implement serialize and deserialize for binary trees preserving shape and signed integer values. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
examples: Tree with root 1 and right child -2 must round-trip with absent left child preserved.
questions.constraints: At most 100000 nodes; empty trees and duplicate values allowed.
questions.reviewerNotes: Explicit null markers or child indices; iterative traversal; unambiguous framing.

questions.prompt: Process addEdge(u,v) on an initially edgeless undirected graph and return component count after each insertion. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.constraints: n,q <= 1000000; duplicate edges and self loops allowed.
questions.reviewerNotes: Path compression and union by rank/size; decrement only on merge.

questions.prompt: Return the largest rectangle area under a histogram of unit-width bars. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.reviewerNotes: Monotonic stack and final flush; wide areas; equal heights.

questions.prompt: Return the fewest cuts partitioning a string into palindromic substrings; empty string needs zero cuts. Implement the solution and analyze its time and auxiliary-space complexity.
questions.constraints: Lowercase ASCII length <= 3000; target O(n^2) time.
questions.reviewerNotes: Palindrome table or center expansion paired with minimum-prefix cuts.
